prompt.es: Escribe el correo de avance a Carlos (170–210 palabras aprox.).

answer.text:
Hi Carlos,

I am writing to give you an update on the volunteer guide. So far, I have completed three of the five sections, and the project is on track overall, although we are slightly behind on the last two sections.

The main obstacle has been a delay in the photos from the school. Without them, I cannot finish the sections about the garden and the library, and I have not been able to start the layout. I have already written to the school twice, but nobody has replied yet.

Meanwhile, I will be writing the two remaining sections, so they are ready as soon as the photos arrive. Next week I will also be testing the guide with two volunteers, and I will be collecting their comments. I will send you a short summary of their feedback on Friday.

I would be grateful if you could contact the school and ask them to send the photos by Wednesday. With your support, I am sure we can still finish on time.

Thank you very much for your help.

Best wishes,
Sara
